name: MedStation
verdict: MedStation recorded $159.10 in Meta spend over 28 days with zero tracked leads, triggering a lead drought flag, while GBP engagement dropped 57.14% week-over-week suggesting reduced local visibility despite 12 calls and 48 direction requests from the Weston profile. The top campaign "MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP" consumed $67.39 of that budget, pointing to awareness-stage creative that is not yet converting to CRM-trackable leads.

performance.verdict: 9 overdue milestones, not ad performance, are the real blocker.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: $159.10 spent across 28 days on Meta with 0 tracked leads and 0 GHL pipeline entries — CPL is undefined because no conversion path exists yet.
9 SOW milestones are overdue as of today 2026-09-15; earliest due 2026-07-31 (stack test, GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, landing pages). No tracking or CRM layer is confirmed live.
Search campaigns, LSA verification, and reactivation nurture sequences were due 2026-08-31 / 2026-09-01; Google spend is $0 across all 28 days — these lanes are dark, not underperforming.

3-day spend signal (Sep 12–14: $6.63, $18.06, $16.26) is volatile but active; GBP actions hit 0 on both Sep 13–14 after averaging ~2.5/day prior 3 days — local visibility declining in parallel with paid ramp.
GA4 sessions average 128/day last 7 days but 0 conversions tracked across 3,275 sessions in 28 days — either no conversion events are configured or landing pages have no form/CTA firing.

suggestions.text: Pause Meta spend at current $14.21/day until end-to-end stack test (F2) is confirmed complete — every dollar now is untrackable.
suggestions.monday_update: Pause the active Meta campaigns (currently ~$14.21/day, $159.10 spent with 0 leads) until the overdue pre-launch stack test and GHL migration are verified complete. Cited: 0 leads from $159.10 spend, 9 milestones overdue since 2026-07-31. Success is confirmed when one end-to-end test touch (ad → tracked lead → GHL opportunity) passes. Re-evaluate by 2026-09-22.

suggestions.text: Configure at least one GA4 conversion event on the landing page — 3,275 sessions and 0 conversions tracked is a broken pixel, not real behaviour.
suggestions.monday_update: Landing pages are receiving sessions (3,275 over 28 days) but GA4 reports 0 conversions, consistent with no conversion event configured or a broken tracking implementation — a known overdue milestone since 2026-07-31. Action: Nacer/Web team to verify form-submit or CTA events fire and appear in GA4 real-time within 48 hours. Success check: at least 1 conversion event confirmed in GA4 by 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 on Sep 13–14 after GBP dropped 57.14% week-over-week — recheck Sep 18 before attributing to paid suppression or listing issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell to 0 on Sep 13–14, and the 7-day window shows a -57.14% decline versus the prior week. This may reflect the overdue GBP triage milestone or a listing quality issue, not ad performance. No action until 3 more days of data are available. Recheck 2026-09-18: if actions remain at 0, escalate GBP listing audit as a blocking issue.
